purpose: Coherent BMS1 outputs, stock comparison and charging-policy audit

snapshot_diagnostic.host_tests: Actual helpers: success, 30 single-operation faults, 4 ownership/consistency/permanent-failure cases, 9 signed36-bit vectors; ASan/UBSan pass
snapshot_diagnostic.build: ARM Alpine Clang22.1.3 W=1 and source checkpatch0 errors/0warnings
snapshot_diagnostic.qualification: Output latch consistency and time variation only; raw values are not calibrated charge or capacity

stock_RAM_baseline.register_reads: Whitelisted BMS/IADC control and calibration fields; debugfs address/count selector writes only, no data writes
stock_RAM_baseline.scope: Stock RAM hardware baseline, not factory restoration; stock kernel may initialize volatile PMIC/gauge state
stock_RAM_baseline.current_direction_observation: Vendor BMS/battery current is negative while Charging; manual IADC current is positive in the same stock window. Do not assign a native sign convention without validation.

configuration_comparison.caveat: Matching readbacks do not prove a mirror address accepts protected calibration writes. Per-unit values remain private.

temperature_policy.additional_policy: Current reduction/voltage-dependent stop above45C; V1_8 uses52C transition and hysteresis. Full policy implementation and tests remain open.
temperature_policy.nominal_comparator_model: At1.8V and using the LG table, normal35%/70% is approximately34.3C/-5.4C; extended25%/80% approximately62.8C/-15.9C. These are model estimates, not measured hardware trip points.
temperature_policy.reason: Extended hardware limits alone do not preserve the stock software charging envelope. Native sensor/fault, inhibit/derating and wake/resume behavior must be qualified first.

limitations: Stock RAM execution is not a factory restoration rehearsal.
No calibrated native BMS, capacity, current direction/absolute accuracy or charger thermal qualification.
